response_weight_provenance.selection: Prospective shadow-only physical tee-state pass-through, not a fitted historical score-outcome coefficient.

historical_score_outcome_audit.outcome_definition: For each target round, absolute field score mean minus the mean of strictly prior round score means, using only golfers with scores in every round through the target (paired active cohort).
historical_score_outcome_audit.regression_definition: Unweighted edition-level OLS; pooled result demeans setup and score deltas within R2/R3/R4 (transition fixed effects).

training_panel.mapping_definition: Within source season (and season-1 for the 2020-23 wrap era), match PGA source event ID to a unique DataGolf player_rounds edition and physical course_num, preferring exact scheduled start/end month-day and then start month-day. If event ID is ambiguous, use exact normalized event name under the same date rules. A single calendar year and course_num are required. No course-name or TOURCAST layout-ID aliases are used.
training_panel.eligibility_definition: Exactly one geometry row per round/hole for R1-R4, 18 holes per round, one layout within each round, stable hole pars, runtime-equivalent par yardage bounds, and no target-round yardage delta beyond 300 yards versus prior-round mean.
training_panel.reference_definition: target round tee expected-strokes index minus the mean index of all strictly prior rounds
training_panel.yardage_precedence: actual_yardage, then canonical yardage, then official_yardage; the audited source schema stores canonical yardage

course_eb_cv.method: leave-calendar-year-out strict-prior RMSE; training rows have DataGolf calendar year strictly less than the held-out edition; same physical course_num needs at least one prior edition
course_eb_cv.global_prior_panel: all eligible geometry editions strictly before holdout calendar year
course_eb_cv.course_prior_panel: exact DataGolf course_num mappings strictly before holdout calendar year

design.observation: Event-round-hole field mean completed-hole strokes; valid hole scores are 1-15 and each cell requires at least 20.
design.formula: mean_hole_strokes ~ yardage_per_10 + event_key:hole_no FE + event_key:round_no FE
design.within_transform: Balanced 4-round x 18-hole two-way demeaning within edition.
design.standard_errors: CR1 cluster-robust by event_key after FE absorption, using the G/(G-1) finite-cluster correction.
design.course_identity: Exact archive metadata calendar year plus PGA event number join to DataGolf (year,event_id), requiring one stable physical course_num; no name, date, or layout aliases.
design.informative_edition: Complete 72-cell score/setup panel with at least 8 holes whose yardage varies across rounds.
design.heterogeneity: Normal-normal marginal ML with mu fixed at the all-edition global beta; reliability=tau2/(tau2+cluster_se^2).
